title: serialRobotInteractiveLimits.py with the new renderer features, checked by hand
author: Claude-JG
description: The example (sliders, mouse drag, end stops) has run only without windows. Decided: adapted later with new features of the renderer.
releaseNotes: serialRobotInteractiveLimits.py moves the Staeubli TX2-90L with the meshes of its URDF by the buttons and sliders of the render window: a slider per joint within its limits, with end stops; 'mouse drag', where the tool follows the mouse by the analytic inverse kinematics and the sliders follow the joints; 'reset'; the pose of the tool in the render window.
